 # ===========================================================================
-# SELF-HOSTING SPIKE — the BEAM abstract-forms backend, written in Rian
+# SELF-HOSTING — the BEAM abstract-forms backend (whole module), in Rian
 # ===========================================================================
-# Goal (ADR-0063 §2, the default BEAM/self-host target): emit Erlang **abstract
-# forms** from the Core IR — the input to `:compile.forms`. This is the
-# Rian-written counterpart of `Rian.Beam`'s `expr_form`, fixpoint-locked against
-# Erlang's OWN parser (`:erl_parse`) in `test/rian/beam_emit_fixpoint_test.exs`:
-# the forms the port builds equal the canonical AST `:erl_parse` produces for the
-# equivalent Erlang expression, term-for-term (annotations normalised).
+# Goal (ADR-0063 §2, the default self-host target): build the Erlang abstract
+# forms for a whole module from the IR — the Rian-written counterpart of
+# `Rian.Beam`'s form generation. BEAM uses Erlang's NATIVE clause matching, so a
+# clause is just `{:clause, [pat forms], guard, body}` — no explicit test/bind
+# generation (unlike the JVM/JS ports); the patterns ARE the dispatch.
 #
-# Because Rian's atom syntax cannot spell operator atoms (`:+`, `:"=<"`), the
-# port carries the Erlang operator as a **string** (it still does the real
-# `erl_op` mapping: `!=`→`/=`, `<=`→`=<`, `and`→`andalso`, `or`→`orelse`); the
-# fixpoint inflates those strings to atoms — a serialisation detail, not the
-# operator logic.
-#
-# Slice: integer/atom/identifier leaves, prefix unary, binary operators. Strings,
-# calls, lists, maps, `case`, and prims are the `:partial` tail — see ADR-0063.
+# Because Rian cannot spell operator atoms (`:+`/`:"=<"`) or Erlang variable atoms,
+# the port emits a `Form` sum carrying the Rian op / name / ctor as STRINGS; the
+# fixpoint (`test/rian/beam_module_fixpoint_test.exs`) inflates them to real forms
+# (the `erl_op`/`var_atom`/`to_snake` conventions), compiles the module via
+# `:compile.forms`, and RUNS it — asserting it behaves identically to
+# `Rian.Beam`. Strings, prims, maps/structs, blocks-with-shadowed-binds, and
+# variable-application are out of scope (the corpus avoids them).
 # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 mod SelfhostBeam do
+  # ── Core (supported subset) ──
   type Core := CNum(String)
              | CId(String)
              | CAtom(String)
              | CUnary(String, Core)
              | CBin(String, Core, Core)
              | CCall(String, Vec(Core))
+             | CTuple(Vec(Core))
+             | CList(Vec(Core), Tail)
+             | CIf(Core, Block, Block)
+             | CCase(Core, Vec(Arm))
+
+  type Tail := TClose | TTail(Core)
+  type Block := Block(Vec(Stmt))
+  type Stmt := SBind(String, Core) | STypedBind(String, String, Core) | SExpr(Core)
+  type Arm := Arm(Pat, Guard, Block)
+
+  type Pat := PWild
+            | PVar(String)
+            | PInt(Int53)
+            | PAtom(String)
+            | PCtor(String, Vec(Pat))
+            | PTuple(Vec(Pat))
+            | PList(Vec(Pat), PTail)
 
-  # An Erlang abstract form (the operator is carried as a string — see moduledoc):
-  #   FInt  -> {integer, _, N}     FVar -> {var, _, Name}   FAtom -> {atom, _, A}
-  #   FUn   -> {op, _, Op, Arg}    FBin -> {op, _, Op, L, R}
-  #   FCall -> {call, _, {atom, _, F}, Args}  (a local function call)
-  type Form := FInt(String)
+  type PTail := PtlClose | PtlTail(Pat)
+  type Guard := GNone | GSome(Core)
+  type Clause := Clause(Vec(Pat), Guard, Block)
+  type Func := Func(String, Int53, Vec(Clause))
+
+  # ── Form (output; strings inflated by the fixpoint) ──
+  type Form := FInt(Int53)
              | FVar(String)
              | FAtom(String)
-             | FUn(String, Form)
-             | FBin(String, Form, Form)
+             | FCtorN(String)
+             | FCtor(String, Vec(Form))
+             | FOp1(String, Form)
+             | FOp2(String, Form, Form)
              | FCall(String, Vec(Form))
+             | FTuple(Vec(Form))
+             | FNil
+             | FCons(Form, Form)
+             | FIf(Form, Vec(Form), Vec(Form))
+             | FCase(Form, Vec(FClause))
+             | FMatch(String, Form)
+
+  type GForm := GfNone | GfSome(Form)
+  type FClause := FClause(Vec(Form), GForm, Vec(Form))
+  type FFunc := FFunc(String, Int53, Vec(FClause))
+
+  pub def compile_forms(Vec(Func)) Vec(FFunc)
+  pub def compile_forms([]) := []
+  pub def compile_forms([f | rest]) := [func_form(f) | compile_forms(rest)]
+
+  def func_form(Func) FFunc
+  def func_form(Func(name, arity, clauses)) := FFunc(name, arity, clause_forms(clauses))
+
+  def clause_forms(Vec(Clause)) Vec(FClause)
+  def clause_forms([]) := []
+  def clause_forms([c | rest]) := [clause_form(c) | clause_forms(rest)]
+
+  def clause_form(Clause) FClause
+  def clause_form(Clause(pats, guard, body)) :=
+    FClause(pat_forms(pats), gform(guard), block_forms(body))
+
+  # ── patterns -> forms (native Erlang dispatch) ──
+  def pat_forms(Vec(Pat)) Vec(Form)
+  def pat_forms([]) := []
+  def pat_forms([p | rest]) := [pat_form(p) | pat_forms(rest)]
+
+  def pat_form(Pat) Form
+  def pat_form(PWild) := FVar("_")
+  def pat_form(PVar(n)) := FVar(n)
+  def pat_form(PInt(v)) := FInt(v)
+  def pat_form(PAtom(a)) := FAtom(a)
+  def pat_form(PCtor(c, [])) := FCtorN(c)
+  def pat_form(PCtor(c, args)) := FCtor(c, pat_forms(args))
+  def pat_form(PTuple(es)) := FTuple(pat_forms(es))
+  def pat_form(PList(es, PtlClose)) := list_form(pat_forms(es), FNil)
+  def pat_form(PList(es, PtlTail(t))) := list_form(pat_forms(es), pat_form(t))
+
+  def list_form(Vec(Form), Form) Form
+  def list_form([], tail) := tail
+  def list_form([x | rest], tail) := FCons(x, list_form(rest, tail))
+
+  def gform(Guard) GForm
+  def gform(GNone) := GfNone
+  def gform(GSome(g)) := GfSome(expr_form(g))
+
+  # ── body / statements ──
+  def block_forms(Block) Vec(Form)
+  def block_forms(Block(stmts)) := stmt_forms(stmts)
+
+  def stmt_forms(Vec(Stmt)) Vec(Form)
+  def stmt_forms([]) := []
+  def stmt_forms([s | rest]) := [stmt_form(s) | stmt_forms(rest)]
+
+  def stmt_form(Stmt) Form
+  def stmt_form(SBind(n, e)) := FMatch(n, expr_form(e))
+  def stmt_form(STypedBind(n, _, e)) := FMatch(n, expr_form(e))
+  def stmt_form(SExpr(e)) := expr_form(e)
+
+  # ── expressions -> forms ──
+  def expr_form(Core) Form
+  def expr_form(CNum(t)) := FInt(parse_int(t))
+  def expr_form(CId("true")) := FAtom("true")
+  def expr_form(CId("false")) := FAtom("false")
+  def expr_form(CId(x))
+    if pascal(x) do
+      FCtorN(x)
+    else
+      FVar(x)
+    end
+  end
+  def expr_form(CAtom(a)) := FAtom(a)
+  def expr_form(CUnary(op, x)) := FOp1(op, expr_form(x))
+  def expr_form(CBin(op, l, r)) := FOp2(op, expr_form(l), expr_form(r))
+  def expr_form(CCall(f, args))
+    if pascal(f) do
+      FCtor(f, expr_forms(args))
+    else
+      FCall(f, expr_forms(args))
+    end
+  end
+  def expr_form(CTuple(es)) := FTuple(expr_forms(es))
+  def expr_form(CList(es, TClose)) := list_form(expr_forms(es), FNil)
+  def expr_form(CList(es, TTail(t))) := list_form(expr_forms(es), expr_form(t))
+  def expr_form(CIf(c, t, e)) := FIf(expr_form(c), block_forms(t), block_forms(e))
+  def expr_form(CCase(scrut, arms)) := FCase(expr_form(scrut), arm_forms(arms))
+
+  def arm_forms(Vec(Arm)) Vec(FClause)
+  def arm_forms([]) := []
+  def arm_forms([a | rest]) := [arm_form(a) | arm_forms(rest)]
+
+  def arm_form(Arm) FClause
+  def arm_form(Arm(pat, guard, body)) := FClause([pat_form(pat)], gform(guard), block_forms(body))
+
+  def expr_forms(Vec(Core)) Vec(Form)
+  def expr_forms([]) := []
+  def expr_forms([x | rest]) := [expr_form(x) | expr_forms(rest)]
+
+  # ── helpers (portable, FFI-free) ──
+  def parse_int(s String) Int53 := digits(Prim.str_chars(s), 0)
+
+  def digits(Vec(Int53), Int53) Int53
+  def digits([], acc) := acc
+  def digits([c | rest], acc)
+    if c == 95 do
+      digits(rest, acc)
+    else
+      digits(rest, acc * 10 + c - 48)
+    end
+  end
 
-  # Rian binary operator -> Erlang operator spelling (the reference `erl_op`).
-  def eop(String) String
-  def eop("==") := "=="
-  def eop("!=") := "/="
-  def eop("<=") := "=<"
-  def eop(">=") := ">="
-  def eop("<") := "<"
-  def eop(">") := ">"
-  def eop("and") := "andalso"
-  def eop("or") := "orelse"
-  def eop("+") := "+"
-  def eop("-") := "-"
-  def eop("*") := "*"
-  def eop("div") := "div"
-  def eop("rem") := "rem"
-
-  # Prefix unary operator -> Erlang spelling.
-  def uop(String) String
-  def uop("-") := "-"
-  def uop("not") := "not"
-
-  # Emit a Core node to its Erlang abstract form.
-  pub def emit(Core) Form
-  pub def emit(CNum(t)) := FInt(t)
-  pub def emit(CId(n)) := FVar(n)
-  pub def emit(CAtom(a)) := FAtom(a)
-  pub def emit(CUnary(op, x)) := FUn(uop(op), emit(x))
-  pub def emit(CBin(op, l, r)) := FBin(eop(op), emit(l), emit(r))
-  # a local function call `f(args)` -> {call, _, {atom, _, f}, [arg forms]} (the
-  # reference's lowercase-`ECall` branch); the callee name rides as a string, the
-  # fixpoint inflating it to the `{atom, _, f}` head. PascalCase ctor-as-tuple is
-  # the `:partial` tail.
-  pub def emit(CCall(f, args)) := FCall(f, forms_of(args))
-
-  # map `emit` over an argument vector (no FFI — a recursive fold to `Vec(Form)`).
-  def forms_of(Vec(Core)) Vec(Form)
-  def forms_of([]) := []
-  def forms_of([x | rest]) := [emit(x) | forms_of(rest)]
+  def pascal(s String) Bool
+    case Prim.str_chars(s) do
+      [c | _] -> c >= 65 and c <= 90
+      [] -> false
+    end
+  end
 end

-  # async: false — loads a real module into the VM via :code.load_binary.
-  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
-
-  alias Rian.{Beam, Core, Pratt}
-
-  # Self-hosting fixpoint (ADR-0063) for the **BEAM abstract-forms backend** (the
-  # default self-host target): a Rian-written forms emitter
-  # (examples/rian/selfhost_beam.rian), compiled to real `.beam`, diffed against

+defmodule Rian.BeamModuleFixpointTest do
+  # async: false — loads real modules into the VM via :code.load_binary.
+  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
+
+  alias Rian.{Beam, Core, Decl, Pratt}
+
+  # Self-hosting fixpoint (ADR-0063) for the **BEAM abstract-forms backend** (whole
+  # module): a Rian-written port (examples/rian/selfhost_beam.rian) builds the
+  # Erlang abstract forms for a module's functions; this test inflates the port's
+  # string-carrying `Form` sum to real forms (the `erl_op`/`var_atom`/`to_snake`
+  # conventions), compiles via `:compile.forms`, and RUNS it — asserting it behaves
+  # IDENTICALLY to `Rian.Beam` over a corpus + inputs. BEAM uses Erlang's native
+  # clause matching, so the port's job is the forms, not test/bind generation.
+
+  setup_all do
+    {:ok, mod} =
+      Beam.load(File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_beam.rian"), :rian_beam_module_fixpoint)
+
+    {:ok, mod: mod}
+  end
+
+  # ── Core struct -> port Core ──
+  defp ic(%Core.ENum{text: t}), do: {:c_num, t}
+  defp ic(%Core.EId{name: n}), do: {:c_id, n}
+  defp ic(%Core.EAtom{name: a}), do: {:c_atom, a}
+  defp ic(%Core.EUnary{op: op, arg: a}), do: {:c_unary, op, ic(a)}
+  defp ic(%Core.EBin{op: op, left: l, right: r}), do: {:c_bin, op, ic(l), ic(r)}
+
+  defp ic(%Core.ECall{fun: %Core.EId{name: f}, args: args}),
+    do: {:c_call, f, Enum.map(args, &ic/1)}
+
+  defp ic(%Core.ETuple{elems: es}), do: {:c_tuple, Enum.map(es, &ic/1)}
+  defp ic(%Core.EList{elems: es, tail: :close}), do: {:c_list, Enum.map(es, &ic/1), :t_close}
+  defp ic(%Core.EList{elems: es, tail: t}), do: {:c_list, Enum.map(es, &ic/1), {:t_tail, ic(t)}}
+  defp ic(%Core.EIf{cond: c, then: t, else: e}), do: {:c_if, ic(c), iblock(t), iblock(e)}
+  defp ic(%Core.ECase{scrut: s, arms: arms}), do: {:c_case, ic(s), Enum.map(arms, &iarm/1)}
+
+  defp iarm({p, g, b}), do: {:arm, ip(p), if(g, do: {:g_some, ic(g)}, else: :g_none), iblock(b)}
+
+  defp iblock(%Core.EBlock{stmts: stmts}), do: {:block, Enum.map(stmts, &istmt/1)}
+  defp iblock(e), do: {:block, [{:s_expr, ic(e)}]}
+
+  defp istmt({:bind, n, e}), do: {:s_bind, n, ic(e)}
+  defp istmt({:typed_bind, n, t, e}), do: {:s_typed_bind, n, t, ic(e)}
+  defp istmt({:expr, e}), do: {:s_expr, ic(e)}
+
+  # ── Core pattern -> port Pat ──
+  defp ip(%Core.PWild{}), do: :p_wild
+  defp ip(%Core.PVar{name: n}), do: {:p_var, n}
+  defp ip(%Core.PLit{value: v}) when is_integer(v), do: {:p_int, v}
+  defp ip(%Core.PAtom{name: a}), do: {:p_atom, a}
+  defp ip(%Core.PCtor{ctor: c, args: args}), do: {:p_ctor, c, Enum.map(args, &ip/1)}
+  defp ip(%Core.PTuple{elems: es}), do: {:p_tuple, Enum.map(es, &ip/1)}
+  defp ip(%Core.PList{elems: es, tail: :close}), do: {:p_list, Enum.map(es, &ip/1), :ptl_close}
+  defp ip(%Core.PList{elems: es, tail: t}), do: {:p_list, Enum.map(es, &ip/1), {:ptl_tail, ip(t)}}
+
+  defp ifunc(f) do
+    clauses =
+      Enum.map(f.clauses, fn c ->
+        pats = Enum.map(c.pats, fn p -> ip(Core.from_pat(p)) end)
+        guard = if c.guard, do: {:g_some, ic(Core.from_expr(Pratt.parse(c.guard)))}, else: :g_none
+        body = iblock(Core.from_expr(Pratt.parse_body(c.body)))
+        {:clause, pats, guard, body}
+      end)
+
+    {:func, f.name, length(hd(f.clauses).pats), clauses}
+  end
+
+  defp funcs_of(%{funcs: [], mods: [m]}), do: m.funcs
+  defp funcs_of(%{funcs: funcs}), do: funcs
+
+  # ── inflate the port's Form sum -> real Erlang abstract forms (anno 0) ──
+  defp inf({:f_int, v}), do: {:integer, 0, v}
+  defp inf({:f_var, "_"}), do: {:var, 0, :_}
+  defp inf({:f_var, n}), do: {:var, 0, var_atom(n)}
+  defp inf({:f_atom, a}), do: {:atom, 0, String.to_atom(a)}
+  defp inf({:f_ctor_n, c}), do: {:atom, 0, Rian.PatternLower.to_snake(c)}
+
+  defp inf({:f_ctor, c, args}),
+    do: {:tuple, 0, [{:atom, 0, Rian.PatternLower.to_snake(c)} | Enum.map(args, &inf/1)]}
+
+  defp inf({:f_op1, op, x}), do: {:op, 0, unary_op(op), inf(x)}
+  defp inf({:f_op2, op, l, r}), do: {:op, 0, erl_op(op), inf(l), inf(r)}
+
+  defp inf({:f_call, f, args}),
+    do: {:call, 0, {:atom, 0, String.to_atom(f)}, Enum.map(args, &inf/1)}
+
+  defp inf({:f_tuple, es}), do: {:tuple, 0, Enum.map(es, &inf/1)}
+  defp inf(:f_nil), do: {nil, 0}
+  defp inf({:f_cons, h, t}), do: {:cons, 0, inf(h), inf(t)}
+  defp inf({:f_match, n, e}), do: {:match, 0, {:var, 0, var_atom(n)}, inf(e)}
+
+  defp inf({:f_if, c, t, e}) do
+    {:case, 0, inf(c),
+     [
+       {:clause, 0, [{:atom, 0, true}], [], Enum.map(t, &inf/1)},
+       {:clause, 0, [{:atom, 0, false}], [], Enum.map(e, &inf/1)}
+     ]}
+  end
+
+  defp inf({:f_case, scrut, clauses}), do: {:case, 0, inf(scrut), Enum.map(clauses, &inf/1)}
+
+  defp inf({:f_clause, pats, guard, body}),
+    do: {:clause, 0, Enum.map(pats, &inf/1), inf_guard(guard), Enum.map(body, &inf/1)}
+
+  defp inf({:f_func, name, arity, clauses}),
+    do: {:function, 0, String.to_atom(name), arity, Enum.map(clauses, &inf/1)}
+
+  defp inf_guard(:gf_none), do: []
+  defp inf_guard({:gf_some, g}), do: [[inf(g)]]
+
+  # Rian.Beam's conventions (replicated so a variant value matches byte-for-byte).
+  defp var_atom("_"), do: :_
+  defp var_atom("_" <> _ = u), do: String.to_atom(u)
+  defp var_atom(<<c::utf8, rest::binary>>), do: String.to_atom(String.upcase(<<c::utf8>>) <> rest)
+
+  defp unary_op("-"), do: :-
+  defp unary_op("not"), do: :not
+
+  @erl_op %{
+    "==" => :==,
+    "!=" => :"/=",
+    "<=" => :"=<",
+    ">=" => :>=,
+    "<" => :<,
+    ">" => :>,
+    "and" => :andalso,
+    "or" => :orelse,
+    "+" => :+,
+    "-" => :-,
+    "*" => :*,
+    "/" => :/,
+    "div" => :div,
+    "rem" => :rem
+  }
+  defp erl_op(op), do: Map.fetch!(@erl_op, op)
+
+  # build, compile, and load the port's module from `src`.
+  defp port_module(mod, src, modname) do
+    prog = src |> Decl.parse() |> Rian.Opaque.erase()
+    funcs = prog |> funcs_of() |> Enum.reject(&(Map.get(&1, :dispatch) == :dispatcher))
+    fn_forms = mod.compile_forms(Enum.map(funcs, &ifunc/1)) |> Enum.map(&inf/1)
+    exports = Enum.map(fn_forms, fn {:function, _, n, a, _} -> {n, a} end)
+
+    forms = [{:attribute, 0, :module, modname}, {:attribute, 0, :export, exports} | fn_forms]
+    {:ok, ^modname, bin} = :compile.forms(forms, [:return_errors])
+    {:module, ^modname} = :code.load_binary(modname, ~c"nofile", bin)
+    modname
+  end
+
+  # corpus: {source, [{fn_name, arg_list}, …]} — run each input on both modules.
+  @corpus [
+    {"def add(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := a + b", [{:add, [2, 3]}, {:add, [10, -4]}]},
+    {"def neg(a Int53) Int53 := -a", [{:neg, [7]}]},
+    {"def cmp(a Int53, b Int53) Bool := a < b and a != b", [{:cmp, [1, 2]}, {:cmp, [2, 2]}]},
+    {"def quot(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := a div b rem a", [{:quot, [17, 5]}]},
+    {"def maxi(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := if a > b do a else b end",
+     [{:maxi, [3, 9]}, {:maxi, [9, 3]}]},
+    {"def fib(n Int53) Int53\ndef fib(0) := 0\ndef fib(1) := 1\ndef fib(n) := fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)",
+     [{:fib, [0]}, {:fib, [1]}, {:fib, [9]}]},
+    {"def sign(n Int53) Int53\ndef sign(0) := 0\ndef sign(n) when n > 0 := 1\ndef sign(_) := -1",
+     [{:sign, [0]}, {:sign, [5]}, {:sign, [-5]}]},
+    # sum variants: construct + dispatch
+    {"type Opt := None | Some(Int53)\npub def mk(n Int53) Opt\ndef mk(0) := None\ndef mk(n) := Some(n)",
+     [{:mk, [0]}, {:mk, [42]}]},
+    {"type Opt := None | Some(Int53)\npub def get(o Opt, d Int53) Int53\ndef get(None, d) := d\ndef get(Some(v), _) := v",
+     [{:get, [:none, 99]}, {:get, [{:some, 7}, 99]}]},
+    # tuple construct + dispatch (Result / case)
+    {"def chk(x Int53) Int53 := case {:ok, x} do\n  {:ok, v} -> v\n  _ -> 0\nend", [{:chk, [5]}]},
+    # list construct + cons dispatch
+    {"def hd(xs Vec(Int53), d Int53) Int53\ndef hd([], d) := d\ndef hd([h | t], _) := h",
+     [{:hd, [[], 0]}, {:hd, [[3, 4, 5], 0]}]},
+    {"def cons(x Int53, xs Vec(Int53)) Vec(Int53) := [x | xs]", [{:cons, [1, [2, 3]]}]}
+  ]
+
+  describe "self-hosting BEAM-module fixpoint — Rian forms run identically to Rian.Beam" do
+    test "the port's compiled module behaves exactly like Rian.Beam's", %{mod: mod} do
+      for {src, calls} <- @corpus do
+        {:ok, ref, refbin} = Beam.compile(src, :"rbm_ref_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}")
+        {:module, ^ref} = :code.load_binary(ref, ~c"nofile", refbin)
+        port = port_module(mod, src, :"rbm_port_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}")
+
+        for {fname, args} <- calls do
+          assert apply(ref, fname, args) == apply(port, fname, args),
+                 "diverged: #{fname}(#{inspect(args)}) on\n#{src}"
+        end
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "teeth — the forms are real abstract forms that compile + dispatch" do
+    test "a multi-clause function dispatches by native pattern (no explicit tests)", %{mod: mod} do
+      src =
+        "def fib(n Int53) Int53\ndef fib(0) := 0\ndef fib(1) := 1\ndef fib(n) := fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)"
+
+      port = port_module(mod, src, :rbm_teeth_fib)
+      assert port.fib(10) == 55
+    end
+
+    test "the port emits a Form, not Erlang atoms directly (Rian can't spell `:+`)", %{mod: mod} do
+      [{:f_func, "f", 1, [{:f_clause, _, _, [body]}]}] =
+        mod.compile_forms([
+          {:func, "f", 1,
+           [
+             {:clause, [{:p_var, "a"}], :g_none,
+              {:block, [{:s_expr, {:c_bin, "+", {:c_id, "a"}, {:c_id, "a"}}}]}}
+           ]}
+        ])

+      # the operator rides as the STRING "+", inflated to the atom by this test
+      assert {:f_op2, "+", _, _} = body
+    end
+  end
